overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance shows that content centered around complex family and husband-wife relationship dynamics ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' with 1768 views, 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' with 1676 views) significantly outperforms general poetry, heavy philosophical shayari, or single-line quotes. Relatable emotional pain points in everyday partnerships are driving the highest engagement.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on post-marriage realities and spousal understanding hit 1.6K+ views consistently (e.g., my5mP9feI7s, or5gtaBpRVY).
winning_patterns.action: Double down on mature relationship dilemmas, unsaid expectations, and modern marital emotional gaps.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framing a relatable question or hidden truth about close relationships trigger higher curiosity click-throughs.
winning_patterns.action: Use conversational, deeply relatable opening questions about everyday relationship struggles.

weak_patterns.pattern: Abstract Sad Shayari and Heavy Philosophical Lines
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' (YdWh4cDOE64) received very low traction (19 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic, poetic, or generic sad shayari that lacks a grounded, real-life anchor.

weak_patterns.evidence: Repeated sister emotional videos with minor title changes (e.g., jfmMztnam_A vs fAAoIQCRMXU) had widely varying and generally low performance.
weak_patterns.action: Diversify the emotional angles instead of repeating exact sibling tropes without a fresh narrative angle.
